mapper.select: SELECT v.outpatientVolume, d.doctorRatioNum, d.doctorRatioDen, r.receptionRateNum, v.outpatientVolume AS receptionRateDen, p.prescriptionRateNum, p.prescriptionRateDen, rec.recordRateNum, rec.recordRateDen, rev.reviewRateNum, rev.reviewRateDen, exe.executionRateNum, exe.executionRateDen FROM ( SELECT COUNT(1) AS outpatientVolume FROM powerihsp_register_order ro JOIN public_order_master om ON ro.order_id = om.order_id WHERE ro.out_date >= #{startDate} AND ro.out_date < #{endDate} + 1 AND ro.order_status != 5 ) v, ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN open_online_consultaation = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS doctorRatioNum, COUNT(1) AS doctorRatioDen FROM powerrsp.rsp_doctor_info ) d, ( -- 接诊率分子：同门诊量口径，ro.order_status<2为未接诊，故取>=2 SELECT COUNT(1) AS receptionRateNum FROM powerihsp_register_order ro JOIN public_order_master om ON ro.order_id = om.order_id WHERE ro.out_date >= #{startDate} AND ro.out_date < #{endDate} + 1 AND ro.order_status >= 2 ) r, ( -- 处方开具率:MEDICALORDERS 有职称医生中西药处方数/挂号量(职称) SELECT SUM(TO_NUMBER(NVL(t.prezhtodaycount, '0'))) AS prescriptionRateNum, SUM(TO_NUMBER(NVL(t.registerntitle, '0'))) AS prescriptionRateDen FROM POWERETL_ODS.MEDICALORDERS t WHERE t.visitdate >= #{startDate} AND t.visitdate < #{endDate} + 1 ) p, ( -- 病历书写率:MEDICALORDERS 有职称医生病历数/挂号量(职称) SELECT SUM(TO_NUMBER(NVL(t.doctorcasetodaycount, '0'))) AS recordRateNum, SUM(TO_NUMBER(NVL(t.registerntitle, '0'))) AS recordRateDen FROM POWERETL_ODS.MEDICALORDERS t WHERE t.visitdate >= #{startDate} AND t.visitdate < #{endDate} + 1 ) rec, ( -- 处方点评率：占位，待接源表 SELECT CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18,4)) AS reviewRateNum, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18,4)) AS reviewRateDen FROM DUAL ) rev, ( -- 药品处方执行率:MEDICALORDERS 支付数/开具数(有职称医生中西药) SELECT SUM(TO_NUMBER(NVL(t.prezftodaycount, '0'))) AS executionRateNum, SUM(TO_NUMBER(NVL(t.prezhtodaycount, '0'))) AS executionRateDen FROM POWERETL_ODS.MEDICALORDERS t WHERE t.visitdate >= #{startDate} AND t.visitdate < #{endDate} + 1 ) exe

SELECT seq, current_value, last_value FROM ( -- 1 总挂号量（含退号）：register order全量计数 SELECT 1 AS seq, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= #{startDate} AND ro.out_date < #{endDate} + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current_value, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= #{lastStartDate} AND ro.out_date < #{lastEndDate} + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS last_value FROM powerihsp_register_order ro JOIN public_order_master om ON ro.order_id = om.order_id WHERE ro.out_date >= #{lastStartDate} AND ro.out_date < #{endDate} + 1 UNION ALL -- 2 净接诊量（不含退号）：同门诊量口径，排除order_status=5退号 SELECT 2 AS seq, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= #{startDate} AND ro.out_date < #{endDate} + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current_value, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= #{lastStartDate} AND ro.out_date < #{lastEndDate} + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS last_value FROM powerihsp_register_order ro JOIN public_order_master om ON ro.order_id = om.order_id WHERE ro.out_date >= #{lastStartDate} AND ro.out_date < #{endDate} + 1 AND ro.order_status != 5 UNION ALL -- 3 病历书写量:MEDICALORDERS病历列区间求和(case为保留字须双引号) SELECT 3 AS seq, SUM(CASE WHEN t.visitdate >= #{startDate} AND t.visitdate < #{endDate} + 1 THEN TO_NUMBER(NVL(t."case", '0')) ELSE 0 END) AS current_value, SUM(CASE WHEN t.visitdate >= #{lastStartDate} AND t.visitdate < #{lastEndDate} + 1 THEN TO_NUMBER(NVL(t."case", '0')) ELSE 0 END) AS last_value FROM POWERETL_ODS.MEDICALORDERS t WHERE t.visitdate >= #{lastStartDate} AND t.visitdate < #{endDate} + 1 UNION ALL -- 4 药品处方开具量:MEDICALORDERS有职称医生中西药处方数(prezhtodaycount,开具率分子) SELECT 4 AS seq, SUM(CASE WHEN t.visitdate >= #{startDate} AND t.visitdate < #{endDate} + 1 THEN TO_NUMBER(NVL(t.prezhtodaycount, '0')) ELSE 0 END) AS current_value, SUM(CASE WHEN t.visitdate >= #{lastStartDate} AND t.visitdate < #{lastEndDate} + 1 THEN TO_NUMBER(NVL(t.prezhtodaycount, '0')) ELSE 0 END) AS last_value FROM POWERETL_ODS.MEDICALORDERS t WHERE t.visitdate >= #{lastStartDate} AND t.visitdate < #{endDate} + 1 UNION ALL -- 5 药品处方执行量:MEDICALORDERS支付数(prezftodaycount,执行率分子) SELECT 5 AS seq, SUM(CASE WHEN t.visitdate >= #{startDate} AND t.visitdate < #{endDate} + 1 THEN TO_NUMBER(NVL(t.prezftodaycount, '0')) ELSE 0 END) AS current_value, SUM(CASE WHEN t.visitdate >= #{lastStartDate} AND t.visitdate < #{lastEndDate} + 1 THEN TO_NUMBER(NVL(t.prezftodaycount, '0')) ELSE 0 END) AS last_value FROM POWERETL_ODS.MEDICALORDERS t WHERE t.visitdate >= #{lastStartDate} AND t.visitdate < #{endDate} + 1 UNION ALL -- 6 挂号费（元）：占位，补源表后删1=2，THEN 1换金额列 SELECT 6 AS seq, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= #{startDate} AND ro.out_date < #{endDate} + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current_value, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= #{lastStartDate} AND ro.out_date < #{lastEndDate} + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS last_value FROM powerihsp_register_order ro WHERE ro.out_date >= #{lastStartDate} AND ro.out_date < #{endDate} + 1 AND 1 = 2 UNION ALL -- 7 检查检验费（元）：占位，补源表后删1=2，THEN 1换金额列 SELECT 7 AS seq, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= #{startDate} AND ro.out_date < #{endDate} + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current_value, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= #{lastStartDate} AND ro.out_date < #{lastEndDate} + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS last_value FROM powerihsp_register_order ro WHERE ro.out_date >= #{lastStartDate} AND ro.out_date < #{endDate} + 1 AND 1 = 2 UNION ALL -- 8 药品处方费（元）：占位，补源表后删1=2，THEN 1换金额列 SELECT 8 AS seq, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= #{startDate} AND ro.out_date < #{endDate} + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current_value, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= #{lastStartDate} AND ro.out_date < #{lastEndDate} + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS last_value FROM powerihsp_register_order ro WHERE ro.out_date >= #{lastStartDate} AND ro.out_date < #{endDate} + 1 AND 1 = 2 UNION ALL -- 9 住院证开具量:MEDICALORDERS住院证列区间求和 SELECT 9 AS seq, SUM(CASE WHEN t.visitdate >= #{startDate} AND t.visitdate < #{endDate} + 1 THEN TO_NUMBER(NVL(t.ryz, '0')) ELSE 0 END) AS current_value, SUM(CASE WHEN t.visitdate >= #{lastStartDate} AND t.visitdate < #{lastEndDate} + 1 THEN TO_NUMBER(NVL(t.ryz, '0')) ELSE 0 END) AS last_value FROM POWERETL_ODS.MEDICALORDERS t WHERE t.visitdate >= #{lastStartDate} AND t.visitdate < #{endDate} + 1 UNION ALL -- 10 药品处方单总数:MEDICALORDERS西药+中药(全部医生口径,与seq4仅职称医生不同) SELECT 10 AS seq, SUM(CASE WHEN t.visitdate >= #{startDate} AND t.visitdate < #{endDate} + 1 THEN TO_NUMBER(NVL(t.prexy, '0')) + TO_NUMBER(NVL(t.prezy, '0')) ELSE 0 END) AS current_value, SUM(CASE WHEN t.visitdate >= #{lastStartDate} AND t.visitdate < #{lastEndDate} + 1 THEN TO_NUMBER(NVL(t.prexy, '0')) + TO_NUMBER(NVL(t.prezy, '0')) ELSE 0 END) AS last_value FROM POWERETL_ODS.MEDICALORDERS t WHERE t.visitdate >= #{lastStartDate} AND t.visitdate < #{endDate} + 1 UNION ALL -- 11 院前检查单数:MEDICALORDERS院前检查列区间求和 SELECT 11 AS seq, SUM(CASE WHEN t.visitdate >= #{startDate} AND t.visitdate < #{endDate} + 1 THEN TO_NUMBER(NVL(t.inhosjcjy, '0')) ELSE 0 END) AS current_value, SUM(CASE WHEN t.visitdate >= #{lastStartDate} AND t.visitdate < #{lastEndDate} + 1 THEN TO_NUMBER(NVL(t.inhosjcjy, '0')) ELSE 0 END) AS last_value FROM POWERETL_ODS.MEDICALORDERS t WHERE t.visitdate >= #{lastStartDate} AND t.visitdate < #{endDate} + 1 ) ORDER BY seq

SELECT ro.consult_type_name AS category, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= #{startDate} AND ro.out_date < #{endDate} + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS currentValue, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= #{lastStartDate} AND ro.out_date < #{lastEndDate} + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lastValue FROM powerihsp_register_order ro JOIN public_order_master om ON ro.order_id = om.order_id WHERE ro.out_date >= #{lastStartDate} AND ro.out_date < #{endDate} + 1 AND ro.order_status >= 2 GROUP BY ro.consult_type_name ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= #{startDate} AND ro.out_date < #{endDate} + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC

SELECT ROWNUM AS rankNum, deptName, currentMonth, lastMonth FROM ( SELECT ro.dept_name AS deptName, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= #{startDate} AND ro.out_date < #{endDate} + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS currentMonth, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= #{lastStartDate} AND ro.out_date < #{lastEndDate} + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lastMonth FROM powerihsp_register_order ro WHERE ro.out_date >= #{lastStartDate} AND ro.out_date < #{endDate} + 1 AND ro.order_status >= 2 GROUP BY ro.dept_code, ro.dept_name ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= #{startDate} AND ro.out_date < #{endDate} + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC )

SELECT ROWNUM AS rankNum, doctorName, deptName, title, currentMonth FROM ( SELECT ro.doctor_name AS doctorName, ro.dept_name AS deptName, ro.doctor_title AS title, COUNT(1) AS currentMonth FROM powerihsp_register_order ro WHERE ro.out_date >= #{startDate} AND ro.out_date < #{endDate} + 1 AND ro.order_status >= 2 GROUP BY ro.doctor_code, ro.doctor_name, ro.dept_name, ro.doctor_title ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC )

SELECT category, dataValue FROM ( SELECT ro.dept_name AS category, ROUND(AVG((ro.reception_time - ro.create_time) * 1440), 0) AS dataValue FROM powerihsp_register_order ro WHERE ro.out_date >= #{startDate} AND ro.out_date < #{endDate} + 1 AND ro.order_status >= 2 AND ro.reception_time IS NOT NULL AND ro.create_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ro.dept_code, ro.dept_name ORDER BY AVG((ro.reception_time - ro.create_time) * 1440) DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 20
